chung.Syllabus Name: Hệ thống ERP: khái niệm và thực hành với SAP_ERP System: Concepts and practice with SAP
chung.Course Name English: ERP System: Concepts and practice with SAP
chung.Time Allocation: Study hour (150h) = 45h (60 sessions) contact hours + 1h final exam + 104h self-study
chung.Description: The course demonstrates concepts, principles, techniques, and applications of ERP systems in general and SAP in particular. The course recalls the components and the structure of an enterprise and introduces the design of SAP that is compatible with this structure. The course also introduces 4 SAP modules including SD (Sales Distribution), MM (Material Management), WM (Ware House Management) and FI (Finance Accouting), . Theory, case study, practical sessions and workshop with SAP
chung.StudentTasks:
- Students must attend at least 80% of contact slots in order to be accepted to the final examination.

- Student is responsible to do all exercises, assignments and labs given by instructor in class or at home and submit on time

- Use laptop in class only for learning purpose

- Promptly access to http://flm.fpt.edu.vn for up-to-date course information

clo: Provide a comprehensive evaluation of ERP systems and business workflows prior to initiating ERP implementation.
Coordinate the orientation and planning for the implementation of foundational ERP modules.
Describe and Demonstrate the ability to implement foundational ERP modules and SAP: their concepts, techniques, navigations and applications.
Describe the integrated order-to-cash cycle (SD), the purchase-to-pay business process (MM), the Warehouse Management (WM) and the Financial Accounting (FI) modules.
Perform simple operations on SD, MM, WM, FI modules
Analyze business case studies and apply SAP system to handle situations
Evaluate all the tasks performed to solve the case studies
Develop professional working style, good teamwork skills and compliance with the production process.
